reviewer.productionAuthorshipDisclosure: Reviewer implemented Wyckoff/SMC/P&F infrastructure earlier, but did not read the held-out prediction map, selected-family labels, or run a production detector while annotating these windows.

methodology.inputs: Only the 24 raw OHLCV JSON files, unlabeled SVGs and REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS in blind-review were read for this review.
methodology.visualization: All 24 complete 256-row charts were inspected; SVGs were rasterized in /tmp with font substitution only. Initial Quick Look thumbnails were cropped and were discarded in favor of complete 1400×680 rendering.
methodology.anchorProcedure: Visible candidate spans selected by the reviewer, then simple min/max arithmetic within those preselected spans resolved precise row anchors. No exhaustive production or substitute harmonic scanner generated annotations.
methodology.harmonicPolicy: Only explicitly calculated ratios can receive a positive harmonic label. The single extended AB=CD label uses a 3% relative ideal-extension band; unmeasured XABCD families are uncertain, not absent.
methodology.classicPolicy: Prefer distinct turns and actual within-window neckline close. Shoulder/double-bottom deviations near 20–25% receive medium confidence; clearly larger asymmetry is not accepted as a typical structure. Range/flag-outline labels are not exact boundary-fit confirmations.
limitations: Mixed random/enriched sample cannot establish population precision or recall.
No claim that shape direction predicted profitable trades.
Elliott/Wolfe and all nine harmonic families were not exhaustively enumerated; lack of a label is not proof of absence.
Some BTC/ETH windows cover the same market episode and are not independent outcomes.

blindReview.scope: family/window agreement against independent blinded AI annotations; ambiguous and unchecked classes excluded; not external-human gold-standard accuracy
blindReview.falsePositiveRateReason: No scored negative family/window labels: TN=FP=0, false-positive rate cannot be estimated.

anchorSummary.scope: Positive annotated structures only. Exact anchor localization and one-bar sensitivity are distinct. Unreviewed predictions are not presumed false. Re-running known windows after repair is regression, not new holdout.
